purpose: minimal fair single-factor comparison: baseline local control vs baseline + one macro-route veto
status: frozen before the P1 run; changing it after seeing results voids the comparison

baseline.note: unmodified v3.7.0 baseline; no parameter changed

hybrid_veto.single_factor: the veto is the only difference from baseline
hybrid_veto.veto_trigger: escape controller intent in {evacuate, emergency} AND a route was found (route_id != null)
hybrid_veto.veto_preserves: shoot and bomb bits from the baseline action, so the bomb protocol is unchanged
hybrid_veto.horizon_note: same 20-frame lookahead as the baseline's horizon_steps x frameskip
hybrid_veto.beam_note: 2 = the baseline's quota_per_action, i.e. two continuations kept per first action

design.pairing: AB/BA balanced random: each pair runs both arms back to back in the recorded order
design.rng_control: unavailable; recorded explicitly, so 'same session' is never reported as 'same curtain'
design.primary_metric: deaths inside the preregistered window [start_frame, start_frame + 1800)
design.exclusions: a pair is a technical failure only if an arm reports technical_failure (clock anomaly, left game, wall budget, unstable snapshot chain); such pairs are listed, not silently removed
design.boundary_rule: a death whose attribution interval crosses the window boundary is counted as boundary_unknown and excluded from the death count, with the event kept in the record
